entities.summary: Peter Andreas Brandt was a Norwegian painter and illustrator. He worked as an illustrator with the Danish paleontologist Peter Wilhelm Lund in Brazil, producing works such as a map of the Lapa Vermelha cavern. Brant lived in the Brazilian town of Lagoa Santa, where he is buried.
